log_level.description: Verbosity of logs emitted by the sandbox. Options: none, info, error, debug.

crash_reporter.description: If true, crash dumps are sent to Google (requires internet access).

root_dir.description: Base directory for sandbox state (logs, sockets, metadata). Must be writable by containerd.

grpc_threads.description: Number of gRPC handler threads. 0 = automatically set to number of CPUs.

nested.description: Enable running Docker or other containerized workloads inside the sandboxed containers (e.g., DinD).

pty.description: Enable PTY (pseudo-terminal) support for interactive shells and terminal-based apps.

debug_enabled.description: Enable advanced debugging features (e.g., netstack logging, verbose trace). Use only for diagnostics.

network_enabled.description: Enable network namespace virtualization. If false, the sandbox shares the host network namespace.

allowed_interfaces.description: Whitelist of network interfaces allowed in the sandbox. Empty list means all interfaces allowed.

allowed_protocols.description: Whitelist of IP protocols allowed for sandbox communication.

mounts.description: Static host-to-sandbox bind mounts. Each entry defines source, destination, and options.

log_to_journald.description: If true, sandbox logs are sent to systemd-journald (or syslog if journald unavailable).

kernel_args.description: Kernel command-line arguments passed to the gVisor virtual kernel (e.g., for debugging).

seccomp_filters.description: If false, disable seccomp filters (not recommended). Enable only for compatibility with legacy workloads.

seccomp_profile.description: Path to custom seccomp profile JSON file. Empty string uses default gVisor profile.

fd_passing_enabled.description: Allow external file descriptors to be passed into the sandbox. Highly discouraged in production.

max_open_files.description: Per-sandbox limit on open file descriptors. 0 means use system limit (ulimit).

cpu_pinning_enabled.description: Pin gVisor threads to specific host CPU cores to reduce latency jitter.

pinned_cores.description: List of host CPU core indices to pin sandbox threads to (e.g., [0, 1]). Requires cpu_pinning_enabled=true.

memory_limit_enabled.description: Enable memory cgroup enforcement for the sandbox.

memory_limit_bytes.description: Maximum memory usage (in bytes) per sandbox. 0 = no limit.

cpu_quota_enabled.description: Enable CPU quota (time-based limit) via cgroups.

cpu_quota_us.description: CPU time (in microseconds) allowed per period.

cpu_period_us.description: CPU period (in microseconds) — standard value is 100ms (100000).

swap_enabled.description: Allow sandbox to use swap space if memory limit is set and exceeded.

overlay_dir.description: Directory for overlay filesystem layers (ephemeral writeable storage).

overlay_enabled.description: Enable overlay filesystem for container rootfs — allows containers to write without modifying base image.
